column1: # cyanrip fork fatal/error message inventory — 104 strings, handshake round 5.
# DERIVED FROM CONTROL FLOW on the fork's side, not from a prefix allowlist: a
# message is listed because its call is followed by `return 1`, a non-zero
# `goto end`. The previous inventory was 88 because it passed through a
# hand-maintained 21-word allowlist on their side, and our surfacing pattern
# missed all 13 matchable strings that allowlist had hidden while this fixture's
# test stayed green — it was describing their filter, not the ripper.
# Re-derived independently on our side at their pin and at the round-4 pin: 104
# both times, a strict superset of the 88 with nothing lost.
# The evidence column matters and is preserved in
# src/platterpus/ripper_message_inventory.py: 73 rows are proven reachable on a
# failure path without reference to wording; the other 31 rest on weaker grounds
# and must not be treated as hard fatals.
# Do not hand-edit. Replaced wholesale when a round ships a new inventory; a diff
# here is a change in what the ripper can say to us.
